pages.title: The Astral Tome
pages.text: A tome bound in starlit hide. Those who read it are never quite human again. Right-click to open its pages and study the ways of the wild.

pages.title: The Ritual
pages.text: Place four materials upon a $(item)Spirit Table$(0), then right-click the table while holding a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0) to seal the offering. If the offering matches a form, the stars will remake you.$(br)Each transformation burns $(thing)5 experience levels$(0).

pages.title: Known Forms
pages.text: $(li)Chen Huang: golden apple, mango, sugar, honey bottle$(li)Petalfall Vernal: petal, sweet berries, glistering melon slice, apple$(li)Moss Beast: tree heart, moss block, vine, spore blossom
